fields.AN_Notes: Workshop report (Werkstattbericht) with three teaching scenarios in social work higher education. Prompting competence is treated as learning content, a declared prompting appendix and Chain-of-Thought prompting are recommended; Role_Persona rests on the role play in which ChatGPT simulates a help-seeking person. Bias is named generically (normierendes und diskriminierendes Potenzial) without an axis or a harm mechanism for the work's own object. The 'Verzerrungen' in the role play scenario concern realism of the simulated client, not social bias. Mitigation is the proposed curricular embedding of the discriminatory potential in teaching. Rammert's technology theory frames AI as an actor, not gender or bias.

fields.AN_Notes: Bias measurement framework (LIBRA, EiCAT metric) for local cultural contexts, applied to New Zealand, a youth corpus and Malaysian English. Language_Culture is the axis the work analyses (local culture, Te Reo Maori and Malay words). The dataset spans eight target groups (age, gender, race/ethnicity, sexual orientation, physical appearance, disability, nationality, religion), but results are reported only in aggregate per model, so these axes are not coded and gender is not an object of the analysis. Disparate_Performance: models fail to understand local non-English words, a quality difference between language varieties. Prompting appears only as a template for definition extraction. Bias is determined explicitly through an adopted definition and the JSD-based measure; the work's call for localized training data is generic and not coded as a mitigation stage.

fields.AN_Notes: Formal hypercube framework for intersectional fairness with proofs, a variance-based metric (VarRatio) and experiments on synthetic data and the Adult dataset. Studientyp borders on Theoretisch; Experimentell was chosen because the results are verified in controlled synthetic experiments with varied bias and a real-data test. Gender, ethnicity and age are the work's own worked examples and the Adult protected attributes (marital status is a further non-coded attribute). Indirect_Discrimination: the work measures outcome disparities of a binary classifier with the disparate impact and statistical parity criteria and finds intersectional bias in Adult; the classification follows the work's own use of disparate impact. Gender is binary by construction (binary protected attributes). No mitigation is applied; bottom-up fairness is a design principle without a stage.

fields.AN_Notes: Debiasing framework for text-to-image generation in which a fine-tuned LLM rewrites generic prompts to match target demographic distributions; evaluated against ground-truth ratios and regex and NER baselines. General_Guidance strategy, verbatim: 'transform generic prompts devoid of demographic specifics into those that are demographically informed'. ICL: few-shot prompting of GPT-3 for training data. The work classifies its method as post-processing; the stage is coded as Prompt_Practice because the intervention changes the prompt before a frozen image model, not the model output. Exclusionary_Norms rests on the work's own observation that generic prompts default to White subjects. Gender is analysed as male and female; the limitation sentence that gender should not be confined to the binary does not change the analysis.

fields.AN_Notes: Experiments on emotional content of responses of seven LLMs to heteronormative versus non-heteronormative prompts and to LGBTQ+ slang. Axes: queer identity expressed through language and queer slang as a language variety (argot). The more negative emotion labels for queer slang are a tone difference and are therefore not coded as Disparate_Performance; Exclusionary_Norms rests on the work's own argument that guardrails against heteronormative language leave a bias against queer language. Existing safety guardrails are discussed as a cause, but no identifiable mitigation is applied or assessed with a stage, so mitigation is None. Gender understanding is recognisable from the heteronormativity frame, which treats binary gender norms and cisnormativity as social norms; Social_Construct is a boundary case because the work states this through the heteronormativity taxonomy rather than a sentence of its own on gender. ICL: GPT-4o tagging prompt with definition and three annotated examples.

fields.AN_Notes: Practice guide for managers and staff in small and medium enterprises with the KI-FAIRNESS prompting framework, organisational measures and illustrative image-prompt trials in DALL-E 2 and Midjourney. Other_Task: drafting job advertisements and recommendation letters in companies. General_Guidance strategy, verbatim: 'Es könnte z.B. explizit gefordert werden, dass Frauen und Männer, Menschen unterschiedlicher Hautfarbe und sozialer Schicht dargestellt werden sollen.' Bias axes and harm types rest on the guide's own image-prompt observations and its own job-advertisement argument; cited news cases are not used. Mitigation status Demonstrated: prompt variations are applied and shown (adding 'divers' changed little), without a completed assessment; the other stages are proposed. Gender is not defined; the guide uses gender-inclusive language and mentions genderqueer people, while its analysis contrasts women and men, so only Intersectional (Women of Color) is coded. Feminist AI, Data Feminism and the Gender Data Gap appear as further reading, outlook and example, not as a frame, so no theory reference is coded.
